as_told.title: Mountain bike incident turns Blitch from skeptic

plain: On a mountain bike ride in 1995 at Daniels Park, a burial ground south-southwest of Denver, Colorado, at least five hours went missing that no one could account for. That is what John Blitch says, a scientist the episode describes as having worked for DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, and he tells it as the man it happened to. He says he had been on the skeptical side until this ride, and it is what turned him toward believing he had been taken by something not human.
